description: This file defines the FilterUninstallValidator class in Drupal, which prevents uninstallation of modules that provide filter plugins currently in use. It manages dependencies on filter plugin definitions, filter formats, and translation services.

classes.name: FilterUninstallValidator
classes.description: A class that implements validation to prevent uninstallation of modules providing active filter plugins.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the validator with filter manager, filter storage, and translation services.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks if the module's filter plugins are in use and returns reasons if so.

methods.name: getFilterDefinitionsByProvider
methods.description: Retrieves filter definitions provided by a specific provider.
